confidence_config.brier_basis: probabilities frozen with each entry; confidence and number separately
confidence_config.conflict: nearest map level to number probability differs from stated level by more than one; log always, display after threshold

definitions.explosive: Rush gain >=10 or pass gain >=20 yards
definitions.momentum: Last four observed games versus own blended mean and standard deviation; mean of YPP z, points-for z, negative points-against z; untested descriptive only
definitions.population: REG only; completed games before as-of and prior to target week
definitions.pressure: FTN was_pressure via nflverse participation, never inferred from sacks/hits
definitions.season_blend: Weeks 1..5: prior season (6-week)/5, current (week-1)/5; Week 6 onward current only. Each team-season receives its declared total weight across its games. Missing current-season games use prior season only through Week 5, explicitly marked PARTIAL.

distribution.integer_rule: nearest integer; half points away from zero; exact residual counts retained separately
distribution.population: REG 2015-2025; reconstructed historical lines, not as-issued T60
distribution.spread_convention: nflverse positive = home favored; inference accepts home handicap (negative = home favored)

feedback.note: Pushes are counted as graded leans but excluded from Brier and binary cover rate; populations never pooled; multi-tag rows overlap.
